name: linux-firmware
description: Collection of binary firmware blobs required by in-kernel drivers (wifi, GPU, network, etc).
install: cd linux-firmware && make DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" FIRMWAREDIR="$PREFIX/lib/firmware" install-zst
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
